notes.title: Free Update, Knight's Saga is out!
notes.notes:
Controller support, massive bug fix, menu change, total overhaul for systems, and 10 Hour extra game play free is finally here! (That includes new music, new smart AI enemy type, tons of new bosses, and an OPEN WORLD to explore!)

Story:
Unknown knight wakes up in a crash to a foreign world. He is jailed but then escapes only to find himself in a conflict between the authoritarian Sarks and those who don’t share the same ideology with her. The player will help knight decide which way to go and eventually, the Knight and his group of friends which he gathers throughout the story will face Sarks and another enemy that is pulling the strings from behind.

The game is a Hack n Slash rpg where players will be able to make decisions and collect items to bring down Sarks! Aside from branching paths and multiple endings, Knight's Saga is lighthearted and fast paced compared to MLBY and Cain's story! 


*Wink wink* I'm sure most of the people will know where all the references are made. Many Youtubers we enjoy are also featured as major characters for this story! We really had a blast making this mode.Definitely let us know if you guys find any bug, but do enjoy this free update. We love you guys and we hope you love us back!

Over 6 months of work means patch notes would be waaaaayyyy too long. But I have included many of the changes in a text file. Ok fine, ill list a couple.

Never Ending Night v 2.3
Added Content

Fixed
-Fixed Menu Save
-Fixed Mlby and Cain final boss door

Never Ending Night v 2.2
Added Content

Fixed
-Fixed restart bug
-Fixed black fade disappearance
-Fixed walking sound
-Fixed background music change
-Fixed music not appearing after quitting to title page

Never Ending Night v 2.1
Added Content
-Added a new default controller binding.
***Control Shift D to reset controller Binding

Fixed
-Fixed Tutorial camera bug
-Fixed double jump in M&C Beginning
-Possibly Fixed Inventory
-Axed Title page music for faster reload

Knight v 2.0
Added Content
-Finished all ambience for Knights
-Named the bard
-Old Construct Factory entrance added
-Short cut to undersurface in castle office added

Fixed
-Possibly fixed Gibberish
-Fixed Fast dialogue line after making a choice
-Nerfed some maps between surface and sarks place
-Added a tiny bit more lanterns throughout M&C games
-M & C Chapter 2,3,4,6,8,10,13, map clean up
-Fixing leviathan bug if dying
-Possibly fixed archive
-M&C zombie fixed + Audio


#KnightsOutForHarambe

notes.title: Knight's Saga free update has an arrival date!
notes.notes:
Dear beloved friends that have supported us this far,

After almost a solid 8 months of work, the upcoming Knight's Saga update is coming! Before I say anything, check out this trailer! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RADyBjzoBVM

So lists. Because everyone loves tl;dr

-6+ Hour of a whole new mode called Knight's Saga (Well, its a new game IMO):
-Controller support for both MLBY and Cain's story AND Knight's Saga!
-Bug fixes for main game

Knight’s Saga is a fast-paced 2D hack and slash game that puts the player in the body of a Knight. The player can explore this metallic world and liberate the citizens from the tyranny of the main antagonist, Sarks, and her allies.

Players will progress through a story while exploring an open world full of unique NPCs. Players will make decisions during events and most interactions, and these decisions will affect the story. Along the way, players will also collect several weapons and armors that modify their knight. These weapons and armors will make it possible to kill the variety of enemies dispersed along the world. The general game flow will include going through a quest, fighting an enemy, and returning the completion of the quest to an NPC.

Knight’s Saga allows the player to enjoy a more traditional combat RPG in the world of Never Ending Night. 

This update features tons of optimization and over 100+ new maps and a whole new series of enemy using our new SmartAI Script. You can also equip your knight with a whole bunch of swords and equipments with game changing effects! Solve quests and those stuff we all love! Games a little hard but you guys are no marshmallow either. Best of all, everything is FREEEEEEE. 

Because we love you guys. More update coming soon! But right now, expect the game to be shipped on September 13, 2016! :D

Follow us on Twitter and Facebook (@DotDreamGames & @NENgame) for more information and details. See you guys around!

Love,
Dot Dream Team

notes.title: Patch 1.4 is live!
notes.notes:
Remember or not remember that super cringy first three chapters? Well the writing has been updated, a bunch of bugs fixed. We also discovered that a lot of bugs came from resolution problem, which is easy to understand on one hand, but on the other, hard to fix. If you are stuck in the beginning, try adjusting the resolution before you start the game! Sorry for the inconvenience, we've tried many things and it didn't work. 

Hopefully this will pacify everyone until our announcement for NEN 2.0 comes out :] Follow us on Twitter or Facebook to get more information on it!

Please, do comment if you find bugs or are stuck somewhere. We will do our best to help. 

Anyway, patch 1.4 log is down below. Check it out please!

*** We suggest everyone to reset their save! Click R, Control R, or Command R accordingly to your OS, during the title page. Then, restart the client***

Known Bugs: Intro tutorial might screw up for certain screen size resolution. If that is the problem, change the resolution higher to accommodate. 

Updated Title Page
Set a fixed ratio for screen ratio

-Added Sound control in Option Screen
-Added a collider under the ship (Just in case)
-Added 1 additional auto talk map 8 for clarification.
-Added additional auto talk map 13 for clarification
-Added glowing particles at exits for clarification.
-Added assets necessary for Knights Revamp

-Fixed intro dialogue
-Fixed map 1 MLBY not touching character in the beginning
-Fixed first map 1 dialogue
-Fixed map 2 dialogues
-Fixed map 3 background change
-Fixed map 3 dialogue
-Fixed map 4 dialogue
-Fixed Colosseum background in boss fight
-Fixed map 8 dialogue 
-Fixed map 9 platform

-Removed spear in map 2
-Removed overall light in map 8
-Removed map 10 setup
-Removed Construct bombers. 
-Removed all spikes from Sewer.

notes.title: Upcoming Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
We are looking to release NEN 2.0, which will feature a whole new Knights mode. More about that will come soon! It will definitely be Less buggy and more fun-sy. Ok, didn't think that one through. 

Anyway, we are looking to release it by mid to early march. But before that we are going to upload a patch that will disable access to our old buggy Knights, while fixing a huge list of bugs for the main game.

We've already finished most of the bug fixes. We will post a list of bug fixed when 1.4 goes live hopefully tonight or tomorrow.

Thank you again for all the support! I know we still have much to fix and clean up, and thank you for all your patience. We are hard at work.

notes.title: Version 1.3 is live!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 10/13/2015

-Added [Esc to pause] on the bottom of the screen. (No one knew.)
-Added "saving…" and a beautiful cog rotating. (So you know the game didn't crash.)

-Fixed dialogue in Chapter 0, 4, 5, 8, 14, 15
-Fixed Chapter 14 falling through lower castle. (Down down and away!)

-Fixed Chapter 10 decision bug (Some people thought this was the end. We had so much more than just showing you an ambiguous dragon! There are 14 chapters in total.)

-Fixed ending so you can actually see one of the 4 endings. May require a restart of the game to take effect. Sorrryyy (Control D or Command D at the title screen.)

-Fixed the credit scene so it accurately reflects the ending type (Again, there are multiple endings :D)



-Removed floating particles in floating island (It used to be a thing where everything you picked up turned small.)

-Removed Chapter 8 beginning overall light (Too bright. Everyone saw the secret area. lol)
-Removed Chapter 8's notorious floating flower

-Removed Chapter 14's first lever and door (It was bugging out so some people were stuck here.)

notes.title: Version 1.1 Is live now!
notes.notes:
We've fixed a bunch of bugs! Here are the specific changes:

Version 1.1 10/5/2015

-Fixed Chapter 3 Saw blade Sound (Thank god. My ear drums were bursting.)
-Fixed running through flying boss fight (We blocked it off. At least, if you do for some reason pass through it, it will re-spawn.)
-Fixed ship not moving on certain machines (This problem only appeared on 1 user's computer. So we tried our very best to fix it.)
-Fixed floating catacomb drop from the left haha
-Fixed Platform moving after re-spawn (Don't try this at home. But sometimes after re-spawning, moving platforms start ghosting around.)
-Fixed Tutorial rock flying around, thereby trapping people in the FIRST 10 SECONDS OF THE GAME (So sad.)

-Took out restart scene from Chapter 0 (Cause it screws up T-T)
-Took out sword from map 3 (It was very annoying 'cause it kept blocking player's way.)

-Added Restart Chapter Button (Click escape to restart chapter. You know. For bugs that we didn't find.)
-Added a check point in Chapter 5. So you don't have to start ALLL the way over.

Many problems reported are computer specific, but we tried to solve it from as much as possible. There will still be bugs, but that is why we are still here :]

-Swineboss
